title: Finite etale Cech cohomology preserves filtered colimits when its sections do
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with abelian sheaves as in [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $U$ be an object, $K$ a finite set and $(f_k:V_k\to U)_{k\in K}$ a family of morphisms (not necessarily a covering). Let $I$ be a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Assume for every $q\geq0$ and $a:\{0,\ldots,q\}\to K$ that evaluation at $V_{a(0)}\times_U\cdots\times_U V_{a(q)}$ preserves colimits of shape $I$. Then, for every $p\geq0$, the functor from abelian sheaves to abelian groups taking $F$ to $\check H^p((V_k\to U)_{k\in K},F)$ [def-weil-pbc-cech-complex] preserves colimits of shape $I$. In particular the image of each colimit cocone, with its original induced legs, is a colimit cocone.

source.place: Tag 0739, lemma-colim-works-over-collection, final paragraph: Cech complexes commute with the filtered colimit and exact filtered colimits preserve their positive exactness

proof.text: By the definition of the Cech complex, its degree q consists of evaluations at the iterated fibre products indexed by tuples a in K^(q+1). This is a finite index set, also when K is empty.

For each q, assemble the assumed evaluation functors into a functor to diagrams over the discrete finite tuple type. Evaluation jointly detects colimits, so this diagram-valued functor preserves the colimit. HasBiproductsOfShape.colimIsoLim identifies the finite product functor with the coproduct functor, which preserves colimits. Pi.isoLimit identifies their composite with the degree-q Cech functor; naturality is Pi.map_π. Degreewise evaluation jointly detects colimits of complexes, so the entire Cech complex functor preserves the colimit.

Uncarry a diagram D of short complexes into a short complex S of functors. The exact filtered-colimit functor L preserves homology. The cocone with vertex S.map L is a colimit because its three projections are the original colimit cocones. Objectwise mapHomologyIso identifies the diagram of its homology with S.homology. mapHomologyIso L identifies the homology of its vertex with colimit S.homology, and homologyMap_mapNatTrans verifies equality of the actual coprojection legs. Hence short-complex homology preserves these colimits. The functor taking the three terms adjacent to degree p preserves colimits, since each evaluation does, so complex homology also preserves them. Compose with the Cech complex functor of step 2.

lean.statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_finiteEtaleCechHomology
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Etale) (K : Type (u + 1)) [Finite K]
    (V : K → X.Etale) (f : ∀ k : K, V k ⟶ U)
    (I : Type u) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (hsections : ∀ (q : ℕ) (a : Fin (q + 1) → K),
      PreservesColimitsOfShape I
        ((sheafSections X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (op (piObj (fun j : Fin (q + 1) ↦ Over.mk (f (a j)))).left)))
    (p : ℕ) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape I
      (sheafToPresheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (Functor.whiskeringLeft (Over U)ᵒᵖ X.Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (Over.forget U).op ⋙
        cechComplexFunctor (fun k : K ↦ Over.mk (f k)) ⋙
        HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p)
